facts.text: The quickstart tells the operator to push the E-Stop button and watch the robot do a glide-stop
The E-Stop service is a heartbeat-based software service; its stop levels are CUT (actuator power is cut immediately), SETTLE_THEN_CUT (the robot stops, sits down, then cuts actuator power) and NONE
The robot can have software and hardware E-Stops at the same time, and if any one E-Stop is activated the robot cannot power on its actuators
Abruptly turning off motor power causes the robot to drop, so clients are encouraged to use SETTLE_THEN_CUT or SafePowerOffCommand; the safe power off sits the robot down before cutting motor power
Robot.power_on blocks until the robot powers on
Robot.power_off(cut_immediately=True) cuts power immediately; cut_immediately=False issues a safe power off command
Robot.get_cached_robot_id returns the RobotId proto, querying it from the robot if it is not cached
Robot.get_cached_usernames returns the sorted usernames matching the serial number in the token cache
Robot.get_frame_tree_snapshot returns the kinematic state's transforms_snapshot
HardwareConfiguration.redundant_safety_stop_enabled says the robot is configured with a redundant safety stop
RobotId carries serial_number, species and nickname fields
